About this information

This website is a separate IBSC redesign preview. Program facts, biographies, and event summaries are paraphrased from official university sources, checked on October 5, 2026. Application requirements and university regulations are administered by Yuan Ze University.

Photographs and the IBSC logo belong to their respective owners. Barlow Condensed and DM Sans are distributed by Google Fonts.

The visual structure is inspired by Princeton University, with IBSC’s own content and a blue palette.
